content_of_post_to_answer: How can I adapt a mindset that makes me reach my goal?
answer: A goal-oriented mindset is less about forcing yourself to feel confident and more about building a system where progress becomes your default behavior. Many people wait for the right motivation before acting, but action is often what creates belief. The overlooked shift is moving from asking “Can I achieve this?” to “What kind of person would naturally do the next step?” Goals become reachable when your identity and daily decisions start pointing in the same direction.
